```{r, warning=F, echo = F}
# Load up utility functions
source("~/VHH/lib/utilities.R")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width=12, fig.height=4) 
```

```{r, warning=F, echo = F}
S1 <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/S1_Rule-based_families24Jan24.csv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
S1$experiment <- rep("S1", each = nrow(S1))
S2 <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/S2_Rule-based_families24Jan24.csv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
S2$experiment <- rep("S2", each = nrow(S2))
S3 <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/S3_Rule-based_families24Jan24.csv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
S3$experiment <- rep("S3", each = nrow(S3))

db <- rbind(S1, S2, S3)

db <- db[!is.na(db$junction_aa),]

db$VHH <- translate_DNA(db$sequence_alignment)

db$junction_aa_length <- NULL

db <- unproductive(db)
```

```{r, warning=F, echo = F}

S1 <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/S1_data_p_genotyped_clone-pass.tsv",
               header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')
S2 <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/S2_data_p_genotyped_clone-pass.tsv", 
               header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')
S3 <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/S3_data_p_genotyped_clone-pass.tsv", 
               header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')

S1$experiment <- rep("S1", each = nrow(S1))

S2$experiment <- rep("S2", each = nrow(S2))

S3$experiment <- rep("S3", each = nrow(S3))

df <- rbind(S1, S2, S3)

df <- df[!is.na(df$junction_aa),]

df$VHH <- translate_DNA(df$sequence_alignment)

df$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(df$junction_aa)

df <- unproductive(df)

# colnames(df)[which(colnames(df) == "clone_id")] <- "family"

rm(S1, S2, S3)


test <- db[which(db$sequence_id %in% df$sequence_id),]
test_two <- df[which(df$sequence_id %in% db$sequence_id),]

#all(test$sequence_id %in% test_two$sequence_id)
#all(test_two$sequence_id %in% test$sequence_id)

db <- test
df <- test_two

rm(test, test_two)

db <- db[nchar(db$junction_aa) == 5,]
```

## Subset families of interest

1. From Hierarchical, Illumina Run `S1`, Group ID: `1581`

2. From Rule-based, Illumina Run `S1`, Group ID `31`

```{r}
# NTGAV families
hdb <- df[df$clone_id == 1585,]
rdb <- db[db$family == 31,]
```

### Print information:

```{r}
cat("Rule-based Family: ", rdb$family[1], " has:\n", nrow(rdb), " VHHs.\n", sep = '')
cat("Hierarchical Family: ", hdb$clone_id[1], " has:\n", nrow(hdb), " VHHs.\n", sep = '')
cat("Rule-based Family: ", rdb$family[1], " and ", "Hierarchical Family: ", hdb$clone_id[1], " share ", length(intersect(hdb$sequence_id, rdb$sequence_id)), " VHHs\n", sep = '')
```

#### Intersection (found in both clusters)

```{r}
db_int <- db[db$sequence_id %in% intersect(hdb$sequence_id, rdb$sequence_id),]

plot_logo(db_int)
```

#### Hierarchical Only Logo-Plot

```{r}
hdb_only <- hdb[!(hdb$sequence_id %in% rdb$sequence_id),]

plot_logo(hdb_only)
```

#### Rule-based Only Logo-Plot

```{r}
rb_only <- rdb[!(rdb$sequence_id %in% hdb$sequence_id),]

plot_logo(rb_only)
```
